name: MINDFUNK In 13 Days
source:
MINDFUNK In 13 Days is a short psychological horror visual novel about trust and control.

MINDFUNK, a cringeworthy soft drink Nari bought on a whim at a reject shop...

Sena can't contain her laughter seeing Nari drink it. He says it tastes exactly how it looks... which gives him a genius idea.

What makes it taste so... weird?

Nari and Sena are lab partners, so Nari decides to investigate what gives MINDFUNK its "unique" taste... What they discover is something they thought was impossible. MINDFUNK vapors produce messages about the future.

MINDFUNK predicts that one of them will die in 13 days.

...This isn't a joke anymore? The wacky drink is saying that one of them only has 13 days left?

Help Nari and Sena escape the grip of MINDFUNK.

...Or don’t. It's up to you to decide how to guide Nari and Sena as they deal with a fortune-telling drink from the past.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4572680]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《MINDFNK In 13 Days》是一部关于信任和控制的短篇心理恐怖视觉小说。

MINDFUNK，一种令人难堪的软饮料，纳里在一家废品店突发奇想买了……

塞娜看到纳里喝了它就忍不住笑了。他说它的味道和看起来一模一样……这给了他一个天才的想法。

是什么让它尝起来如此……奇怪？

Nari和Sena是实验室合作伙伴，因此Nari决定调查是什么赋予了MINDFUNK其“独特”的味道……他们发现的是他们认为不可能的东西。MINDFUNK蒸气产生有关未来的信息。

MINDFUNK预测其中一人将在13天后死亡。

……这已经不是玩笑了？奇怪的饮料说其中一个只剩下13天了？

帮助纳里和塞娜逃离MINDFUNK的魔掌。

…或者不。由你来决定如何引导纳里和塞娜处理过去的算命饮料。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4572680]Itch.io[/url]]
